candidates.change_summary: Replace 'pot += msg.value' with 'pot = msg.value' so pot no longer accumulates across multiple plays.
Delete 'pot += msg.value' so the ticket payment is never added to pot.
Delete 'pot = 0;' so a win no longer resets pot to zero.
Replace 'pot = 0;' with 'pot = FEE_AMOUNT;' so a win leaves pot at 1 instead of 0.
Replace '% 2' with '% 3' so the win condition can still trigger but only one third of the time, changing when pot is reset.
Replace 'pot += msg.value' with 'pot += FEE_AMOUNT' so only 1 wei is added to pot per play.
Delete the statement that adds the ticket payment to the pot, so pot no longer accumulates the caller's deposit.
Change the pot accumulation to add the fixed ticket amount constant instead of the actual msg.value.
Change the win condition from random == 0 to random == 1, altering which call outcomes reset the pot.
Delete the statement resetting the pot to zero after a win, so pot retains accumulated funds.
Loosen the ticket price check from exact equality to a minimum, allowing calls with larger msg.value.
Change the pot increment from msg.value to msg.value + 1 so pot grows faster than in P.
Delete the pot increment so pot is never updated on entry to play.
Delete the pot reset after a win so pot retains its value after a payout.
Change the pot reset value from 0 to 1 so pot is 1 instead of 0 after a win.
Move the pot = 0 statement out of the if block to the end of the function so pot is reset even on losing plays.
Delete the statement `pot = 0;` so the pot is never reset after a winning play.
Replace `pot += msg.value;` with `pot = msg.value;` so the pot is overwritten rather than accumulated.
Replace `pot = 0;` with `pot = FEE_AMOUNT;` so a nonzero amount remains in the pot after a win.
Move `pot = 0;` to the start of the if-block, before the transfers, making payouts zero.
